notes:
Summary: mid-market CX platform focusing on automated ticket triage and summarization for multi-product SaaS. Primary goal: reduce AHT and speed first-response for Level 1 agents via concise summaries + suggested macros.

POC scope and success metrics:
- Ingest 10k historical Zendesk tickets (English, product=A/B/C) + email threads.
- Auto-generated 1-2 sentence ticket summary (human-readable) per conversation; target avg latency for online agent assist <= 600ms, background bulk summarization throughput >= 2000 tickets/hr.
- Auto-tagging: map to 20-rule taxonomy, target precision >= 88% at confidence threshold 0.75. Tags drive macros + routing.
- Macro invocation safety: suggestions shown to agent; auto-apply only for tags with >0.9 confidence and audit log.

Technical notes / asks:
- Must integrate into Zendesk via App + webhooks; Freshdesk considered for European customers.
- Need streaming / incremental summarization so agents see a draft within 300-500ms while generation completes.
- Prefers hosted API initially but requires VPC peering for event ingestion and a Bring-Your-Own-KMS option.
- Spike handling: experiences 4x traffic spikes during releases; requires graceful throttling, fallback to lightweight model (cheaper variant) and queueing, and per-customer rate SLA.
- Requires audit logs for automated actions (tag applied, macro run) and retention controls (customer 7y policy for some accounts).

Security / compliance:
- Primary blockers: data residency for EU customers (want model inference in-region), SOC2 attestation, SSO/SAML for app install, and papered DPA.
- Legal: needs confirmation on whether Redwood retains raw text for training; must be able to opt-out / exclude.

Business context and constraints:
- Currently fielding ~15k tickets/month; majority English. Peak concurrency ~180 reqs/min.
- Cost sensitive but willing to pay for reliability and auditability. Dedicated capacity on roadmap if POC successful.
- Quote from Head of Support: "If we can cut triage time by half and avoid false escalations, this pays for itself."

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to provision sandbox app + sample ingestion guide (by 2026-03-13).
- Citrine to prepare 10k-ticket export (anonymized) and tag mapping document.
- Security call 2026-03-15 to review SOC2, KMS, retention options.

Notes are intentionally concise, with action items. Expect follow-up on tagging edge cases (multi-issue tickets) and internationalization (EN/ES).
minor_notes: Client prefers Zendesk macros to remain source-of-truth; wants Redwood suggestions to surface as pre-macros not replacements. POC budget approved up to $15k.
